title: Trump suggests limited strikes to push Iran to nuclear deal
description: On Friday, President Trump suggested he was considering a limited strike on Iran. The public statements come as the United States continues to deploy a large number of military assets in the region and as Iran’s foreign minister said he was drafting a new diplomatic proposal as part of ongoing negotiations. Nick Schifrin reports.

title: US and Iran slide towards conflict as military buildup eclipses talks
description: DUBAI, Feb 20 - Iran and the United States are sliding rapidly towards military conflict as hopes fade for a diplomatic solution to their standoff over Tehran’s nuclear programme, officials on both sides and diplomats across the Gulf and Europe say. Read more at straitstimes.com.

title: Analysis-US and Iran slide towards conflict as military buildup eclipses talks
description: By Samia Nakhoul, Parisa Hafezi and John IrishDUBAI, Feb 20 (Reuters) - Iran and the United States are sliding rapidly towards military conflict as hopes fade for a diplomatic solution to their standoff over Tehran’s nuclear programme, officials on both sides and diplomats across the Gulf and Europe say.Iran’s Gulf neighbours and its enemy Israel now consider a conflict to be more likely than a settlement, these sources say, with Washington building up one of its biggest military deployments in the region since the invasion of Iraq in 2003.

title: 'Saudi Arabia may have uranium enrichment chapter in US deal'
description: Saudi Arabia could develop uranium enrichment facilities under a proposed nuclear agreement with the United States. This development raises concerns about nuclear proliferation, especially with ongoing tensions surrounding Iran's nuclear program. Previous US administrations also sought similar nuclear deals with the kingdom.

title: The Latest: Trump considers limited strikes on Iran even as diplomat says proposed deal is near
description: President Donald Trump has warned that limited strikes against Iran are possible even as the country’s top diplomat said Tehran expects to have a proposed deal ready in the next few days following nuclear talks with the United States. In response to a reporter’s question on whether the U.S. could take limited military action as the countries negotiate, Trump said, “I guess I can say I am considering that.” Earlier, Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi said in a TV interview that his country was planning to finalize a draft deal to then send to Washington.

title: Trump warns Iran he's considering limited strikes
description: U.S. President Donald Trump warned on Friday that limited strikes against Iran are possible even as the country’s top diplomat said Tehran expects to have a proposed deal ready in the next few days following nuclear talks with the United States.

title: Trump Warns He's Considering Limited Strikes as Iranian Diplomat Says Proposed Deal Is Imminent
description: WASHINGTON (AP) — President Donald Trump warned on Friday that limited strikes against Iran are possible even as the country’s top diplomat said Tehran expects to have a proposed deal ready in the next few days following nuclear talks with the United States.
